subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the durable-approval stack be relanded on a clean current-main branch rather than repairing this conflicted aggregate?
rationale: The useful approval work is mixed with widespread unrelated rollback and multiple blocking defects, so the landing shape requires explicit maintainer risk ownership.

options.title: Reland narrowly
options.body: Create a current-main branch from the intended approval stack and add only independently reviewed gate repairs.

options.title: Repair in place
options.body: Resolve conflicts and restore every unrelated current-main invariant before rerunning whole-tree review and proof.

options.title: Pause this aggregate
options.body: Defer landing until a narrow, reviewable replacement branch is ready.

recommendation.title: Reland narrowly
recommendation.body: Create a current-main branch from the intended approval stack and add only independently reviewed gate repairs.

likelyOwner.reason: The aggregate and its incorporated approval-stack commits were authored and coordinated by this person.
